themes.title: Saudi sovereign-AI sprint: Mistral-HUMAIN, quantum, Paris deals
themes.summary: Riyadh is converting Vision 2030 ambition into contracts: Mistral and HUMAIN agreed a 'hundreds-of-millions' sovereign-AI collaboration for the Kingdom and the region, and French exposure to Saudi — now put at $21B — is expanding beyond energy into AI and digital infrastructure. Quantum vendor Pasqal and Eleven Ventures also launched a commercial joint venture to scale quantum and AI computing across Saudi Arabia and MENA.
themes.angle: Sovereign AI is moving from policy talk to paid enterprise deployments GCC executives should price in now.

themes.title: Nvidia warns customers of ~15% Blackwell/Rubin price hikes
themes.summary: Bloomberg reports Nvidia is notifying customers of possible price rises of around 15% on Blackwell- and Rubin-based AI systems as soaring memory (HBM/DRAM) costs ripple through the infrastructure build-out. The squeeze lands days before Nvidia's earnings and raises the capex arithmetic of every hyperscaler and enterprise standing up AI clusters.
themes.angle: Memory-cost inflation is the sleeper line item in 2026 AI budgets — CFOs should re-run compute ROI now.

themes.title: Meta 'Hatch' AI agent platform set to roll out soon
themes.summary: Meta is preparing to launch 'Hatch', an AI agent platform, and a new 'Watermelon' model in a monetization push, per The Information (corroborated by TradingView). For enterprises deciding who owns the agent layer, a second big superplatform now enters the race alongside OpenAI and Anthropic.
themes.angle: Meta entering the agent-platform race makes the 'agent middleman' battleground three-way — a channel decision CIOs must track.

themes.title: DeepSeek-powered autonomous hacking, countered by UAE AI
themes.summary: Multiple sources report China-linked attackers embedding open models such as DeepSeek into their operations to launch cyberattacks, while the UAE says it is fighting AI-driven hackers with AI of its own (Rest of World). Governments are also hardening supply chains after an Iran-linked cyberattack (FT).
themes.angle: AI-on-AI defensive posture is becoming table stakes; boards should audit their exposure to model-enabled threats.

themes.title: Power becomes the binding AI constraint in Abu Dhabi
themes.summary: GCC business press says Abu Dhabi electricity demand is set to double by 2050 as AI-led and economic expansion accelerate, echoing what TerraPower's CEO says is now the primary driver of nuclear demand: hyperscalers. Energy in the Gulf is becoming the binding bottleneck for AI expansion.
themes.angle: Power, not silicon, is the next competitive constraint — Gulf AI builds must anchor on energy premises.

themes.title: Dev-side: GPT-5.6 in Kiro, Ray on SageMaker HyperPod
themes.summary: OpenAI is shipping GPT-5.6 in Kiro to help developers plan, build, review and test software with better price-performance, and AWS brought new Ray capabilities to SageMaker HyperPod to support larger, more parallel training and inference workloads. Bets land on AI-native software delivery economics.
themes.angle: Dev-platform price-performance is front-and-center for the AI-native SDLC migration.
